svg.title: 主人公・front 歩行 3
svg.desc: Front derived from the supplied girl_idle.png with its matte removed; back is an adaptation of it (unseen details are not assertions about the original design). Left/right are the supplied girl_left.png and girl_right.png cleaned on the original 60x60 grid: white matte, floor oval and broken curl pixels removed, edge colours un-blended from the background. Walk frames only reposition the legs.
